metadata.question: Within a 100 km radius of (-1.593993, -49.053062) in the Amazon Rainforest, on August 19, 2009, is there a greater presence of cloud cover over land areas compared to river areas?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location). - Use Landsat 5 TM Collection 2 Level-2 (primary for 2009). If empty, try Landsat 7 ETM+ L2. If still empty, widen window around 2009-08-19: same day, ±3 days, then ±7 days. - Area: 100 km radius around point (-1.593993, -49.053062). 2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?). - We must detect cloud presence, not mask it out. Use QA_PIXEL bitmask: cloud = Cloud OR Dilated Cloud OR Cirrus; valid = not Fill. Count cloud pixels over water vs land. - Water mask: JRC Global Surface Water occurrence (>50%) to represent river areas robustly. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3). - If image collections empty after recovery attempts: C1. - If either water or land valid pixel count is 0: C2. - If any computed fraction is null/NaN or outside [0,1]: C3. - Else compare cloud fraction over land vs water: land > water => A: Yes, else B: No. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function getInfoAsync(obj) { return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { obj.getInfo((res, err) => { if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res); }); }); } function makeWindow(baseDateStr, padDays) { const start = ee.Date(baseDateStr).advance(-padDays, 'day'); const end = ee.Date(baseDateStr).advance(padDays + 1, 'day'); // end is exclusive return { start: start, end: end }; } function getCollection(sensorId, geom, start, end) { return ee.ImageCollection(sensorId) .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate(start, end); } function buildCloudMaskFromQAPixel(img) { const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const fill = qa.bitwiseAnd(1).neq(0); const valid = fill.not(); const dilated = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).neq(0); const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0); const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0); const isCloud = dilated.or(cirrus).or(cloud); return { valid: valid, isCloud: isCloud }; } async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const roi = ee.Geometry.Point([-49.053062, -1.593993]).buffer(100000); // 100 km const baseDate = '2009-08-19'; const windows = [0, 3, 7]; // same day, ±3 days, ±7 days const sensors = [ { id: 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', name: 'LT05' }, { id: 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', name: 'LE07' } ]; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback let chosen = null; let chosenCol = null; for (let w of windows) { const win = makeWindow(baseDate, w); for (let s of sensors) { const col = getCollection(s.id, roi, win.start, win.end); const sz = await getInfoAsync(col.size()); if (sz > 0) { chosen = { sensor: s.name, sensorId: s.id, start: await getInfoAsync(win.start.format('YYYY-MM-dd')), end: await getInfoAsync(win.end.format('YYYY-MM-dd')), size: sz, padDays: w }; chosenCol = col; break; } } if (chosen) break; } if (!chosen) { console.log('Selected: None'); console.log('Reason: No images found for date/location (after fallbacks).'); console.log('C1: Empty Collection'); return; } console.log('Selected:', chosen.sensor, 'Win:', chosen.start, 'to', chosen.end, 'Images:', chosen.size); // 3. Build mosaic image (keep QA_PIXEL for cloud flags) const mosaic = chosenCol.sort('CLOUD_COVER').mosaic().clip(roi); // 4. Water (river) vs Land masks using JRC Global Surface Water occurrence const gsw = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater').select('occurrence'); const waterMask = gsw.gt(50); // >50% occurrence as river/water const landMask = waterMask.not(); // 5. Cloud detection using QA_PIXEL const qaBands = buildCloudMaskFromQAPixel(mosaic); const valid = qaBands.valid; const isCloud = qaBands.isCloud; // Valid masks per class const validWater = valid.and(waterMask); const validLand = valid.and(landMask); // 6. Counts at coarse scale to avoid timeout const scale = 1500; // meters const ones = ee.Image.constant(1).toInt(); const waterCountImg = ones.updateMask(validWater); const waterCloudCountImg = ones.updateMask(validWater.and(isCloud)); const landCountImg = ones.updateMask(validLand); const landCloudCountImg = ones.updateMask(validLand.and(isCloud)); const waterDict = waterCountImg.addBands(waterCloudCountImg.rename('cloud')) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().repeat(2).setOutputs(['total', 'cloud']), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, tileScale: 2 }); const landDict = landCountImg.addBands(landCloudCountImg.rename('cloud')) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().repeat(2).setOutputs(['total', 'cloud']), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, tileScale: 2 }); const waterStats = await getInfoAsync(waterDict); const landStats = await getInfoAsync(landDict); const wTotal = waterStats ? waterStats.total : null; const wCloud = waterStats ? waterStats.cloud : null; const lTotal = landStats ? landStats.total : null; const lCloud = landStats ? landStats.cloud : null; // 7. Validation for C2/C3 if (!wTotal || !lTotal || wTotal === 0 || lTotal === 0) { console.log('Valid Pixels - Water:', wTotal || 0, 'Land:', lTotal || 0); console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels'); return; } const wFrac = wCloud / wTotal; const lFrac = lCloud / lTotal; const invalid = [wFrac, lFrac].some(v => v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v) || v < 0 || v > 1); if (invalid) { console.log('Calculation invalid. wFrac:', wFrac, 'lFrac:', lFrac); console.log('C3: Calculation Failure'); return; } // 8. Print concise stats const cloudAllDict = ones.updateMask(valid.and(isCloud)).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, tileScale: 2 }); const totalAllDict = ones.updateMask(valid).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, tileScale: 2 }); const cloudAll = await getInfoAsync(cloudAllDict).then(d => d.sum || 0); const totalAll = await getInfoAsync(totalAllDict).then(d => d.sum || 0); const allFrac = totalAll > 0 ? (cloudAll / totalAll) : null; console.log('Water Pixels:', wTotal, 'Cloud:', wCloud, 'Cloud%:', (wFrac * 100).toFixed(1)); console.log('Land Pixels:', lTotal, 'Cloud:', lCloud, 'Cloud%:', (lFrac * 100).toFixed(1)); if (allFrac !== null) { console.log('Overall Cloud% (valid area):', (allFrac * 100).toFixed(1)); } console.log('Water mask: GSW occurrence > 50%'); console.log('Cloud bits: QA_PIXEL (Dilated | Cirrus | Cloud)'); // 9. Final Answer if (lFrac > wFrac) { console.log('A: Yes'); } else { console.log('B: No'); } } catch (err) { console.log('Error:', (err && err.message) ? err.message : String(err)); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
